#QUESTION 8
```{r}
mu_policies = function(abbrv){
  policy_url = paste0(
    'https://miamioh.edu/policy-library/students/undergraduate/academic-regulations/'
  )
  
  webpage = rvest::read_html(policy_url)
  
  webpage |> rvest::html_elements("a") -> policy_name
  webpage |> rvest::html_attr("href") -> mu_policies
    
    }
```

```{r}
##ANSWER

'https://miamioh.edu/policy-library/students/undergraduate/academic-regulations/index.html' |> 
  rvest::read_html() |> 
  rvest::html_elements('a.news-lockup__body-link') |> 
  rvest::html_attr(name = 'href') |> 
  # optional to make absolute URLs instead of partials
  rvest::url_absolute('https://miamioh.edu/policy-library/') -> mu_policies

mu_policies
```
